product_one_liner.value: Wellinks provides virtual COPD care, pulmonary rehabilitation, remote patient monitoring, and care-management support for health plans, providers, health systems, and their patients.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage directly describes the services and the health plans, providers, and health systems they serve. Source: https://www.wellinks.com/

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer do not link to pricing; the commercial contact page offers a business-inquiry form rather than plans or prices. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/ and https://www.wellinks.com/contact-us

value: Highmark Blue Cross Blue Shield Delaware
named_customers.notes: named_customers: UMass Memorial Health is identified through a patient-care deployment, independently of its investor relationship. Highmark Delaware signed an agreement for Wellinks to deliver COPD care to its members. These are service-delivery relationships, not merely investor or promotional partnerships. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/news/wellinks-integrates-virtual-pulmonary-rehabilitation-program-at-umass-memorial-health-for-massachusetts-residents-living-with-copd and https://www.wellinks.com/blog/wellinks-and-highmark-blue-cross-blue-shield-delaware | named_customers.0: The program is offered to UMass Memorial Health patients following hospitalization and through outpatient care, establishing a service-deployment relationship beyond investment. | named_customers.1: The announcement describes an agreement to deliver Wellinks COPD services to Highmark Delaware members, rather than an investor-only relationship.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 29 employees, which maps to 21-50. The source does not supply a headcount measurement date. Source: https://platform.tracxn.com/a/d/company/54f00369e4b06f2d931ca33a/wellinks

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company explicitly identifies New Haven as its headquarters city. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/wellinkscareers/jobs/978b901e-c8b6-4f70-9679-d94650a4b133

founded_year.notes: The company explicitly states it was founded in 2012. Source: https://www.wellinks.com/news/wellinks-acquires-spire-health-creating-industry-leader-in-predictive-patient-care-for-cardiopulmonary-health

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains clinical, product, and company-news content rather than two qualifying engineer-authored accounts of product implementation. Source: https://www.wellinks.com/resources/blog

public_docs.notes: Several public patient-facing product-help articles provide app and device instructions, satisfying the documentation criterion without requiring a developer portal. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/article/wellinks-app-action-plan, https://www.wellinks.com/article/how-to-add-a-spirometry-reading, and https://www.wellinks.com/article/bluetooth-connectivity-guide-for-android-and-ios-devices

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board lists one role, Senior Data and BI Analyst, which is explicitly excluded from qualifying AI/ML roles by the question. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/wellinkscareers/jobs

model_provider.notes: No specific AI model or provider was identified in the reviewed product pages, patient documentation, AI-related blog material, or privacy disclosures. The product describes proprietary Spire data and predictive algorithms, which do not identify a particular model. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/predictive-patient-care, https://www.wellinks.com/legal/privacy-policy, and https://www.wellinks.com/article/how-to-add-a-spirometry-reading

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The blog footer displays a SOC 2 certification seal, and the privacy policy explicitly claims HIPAA privacy obligations. HIPAA is included as a publicly claimed compliance framework, not as an independently verified certification. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/resources/blog and https://www.wellinks.com/legal/privacy-policy | compliance_certs.0: The blog footer explicitly displays a SOC 2 certification seal. | compliance_certs.1: The privacy policy explicitly commits to maintaining health-information privacy as required by HIPAA.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million Series B announced August 4, 2026 falls within the requested 18-month window. Source: https://www.wellinks.com/news/wellinks-closed-10-million-series-b-funding-from-umass-memorial-health-and-inside-investors

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The sole listed opening is Senior Data and BI Analyst, not SDR, BDR, or account executive. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/wellinkscareers/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog and news histories show no qualifying product or major-feature launch within the six-month window. The 2026 leadership announcement is not a product launch; the displayed product-related blog announcements predate the window. Sources: https://www.wellinks.com/resources/blog and https://www.wellinks.com/resources/news

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The August 31, 2026 announcement identifies Stephanie Solich as joining as Vice President of Customer Success, within the requested 12-month window. Board appointments alone were not counted. Source: https://www.wellinks.com/news/wellinks-appoints-andrew-agwunobi-and-mike-waters-to-board-of-directors-and-expands-management-team

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting names analytics and data tools but no CRM, sales, or marketing system. The reviewed documentation likewise supplied no qualifying system. Source: https://ats.rippling.com/wellinkscareers/jobs/978b901e-c8b6-4f70-9679-d94650a4b133
